nodes.label: Trilbit RPG economy and integrity rules
Consumable eligibility, checkpoint restrictions and reviewed content coverage
nodes.rationale: Only the final graded question of checkpoint points 5 and 10, or an explicitly essential original question, blocks skip/swap. Other practice remains eligible. Six consumables belong to the lesson bag; shields and cosmetics belong to account inventory. Reviewed examples and swaps cover 11 of 129 published questions.

nodes.label: XP, Bits, level formula and once-only learning rewards
nodes.rationale: XP combines lessons and achievements. Bits alone purchase items. Valid first lesson completion gives 10 Bits, perfection adds 5, and first valid daily completion adds 10 once per Sao Paulo date.

nodes.label: Atomic wallet transactions, unique events and idempotent operation UUIDs
nodes.rationale: Wallet-first locking, unique records and same-UUID replay prevent duplicate rewards, overspending, duplicate consumption and aid applied after a saved answer.

nodes.label: Verified materials, real study days and advance streak protection
nodes.rationale: A material needs at least 15 server-timed seconds and a correct conceptual check. A shield covers one eligible missed day without inventing a study day, XP or Bits.
